name: fittest
title: Launcher fit test: chamber, sled, free-standing leaves and pins at three clearances each
orientation: Flat on the bed as drawn, no supports. Try each and note which number moves freely and which pin holds: (1) push the disc and the sled coupon, on edge, through each channel: it should slide under its own weight when tilted, and pass under the roof; (2) flick each leaf: it should swing freely, touching nothing but its root; (3) push each pin, A, B and C (one, two or three flats on its foot), through each hole in the wall until it clicks, then pull. The numbers are the gap per side, in mm.

plate.label: The plate: channels, leaves and the pin wall

coupon.label: A sled coupon: a slice of the sled's plate

pin_a.label: Pin A: 0.4 mm barb, 45° back (as printed before)

gaps.rule: The smallest gap tried, per side; then one and two steps more

step.rule: The step between the gaps tried

floor.rule: The base, as the cartridges' floors

disc_t.rule: The disc's thickness, and the sled coupon's

roof_l.rule: The roof over each channel's middle: where the frame's back plate would be

leaf_t.rule: The test leaves' thickness: the bow's four lines

leaf_h.rule: The test leaves' height: fifty layers

root.rule: Each leaf's root block, on the floor

travel.rule: The window's room for the leaf to swing each way, past its gap

pin.rule: The pins' diameter, as the launcher's

pin_len.rule: The pins' shaft: through the frame's skin and a cartridge's wall, as the launcher's

pin_wall.rule: The test wall's thickness: what a pin goes through

hole_gaps.rule: The smallest radial clearance round a pin tried; then twice and four times it (the launcher had 0.2)

head.rule: The pins' foot past the shaft

slot.rule: The split down each pin, as the launcher's

label_t.rule: Labels stand this proud of the floor

smooth.rule: Segments round the disc, pins and holes

lip_a.rule: Pin A's barb: as the launcher's pins, which fell out

lip_b.rule: Pin B's barb: half as much again (1.6% strain in the split halves)

back_b.rule: Pin B's barb's back: lets go with a pull

back_c.rule: Pin C's barb's back: steep, so it holds (squeeze the halves to take it out)

flat.rule: How deep each flat on a pin's foot is: one, two or three of them say A, B or C
